aiSummary.title: AI Summary
aiSummary.urgentAction: Project Orion requires a decision within 48 hours to avoid a 3-week overall delay.
aiSummary.recommendation: Immediate action recommended on 1 project. The 3 other orange risks can be handled within the week.

orion.description: The main supplier announced a 3-week delivery delay for critical components. This situation blocks project progress and requires a quick decision to avoid cascading impact on other projects.
orion.action2: Evaluate in-house production option (10-day lead time)
orion.action3: Negotiate financial compensation with current supplier

phoenix.description: Current team is overloaded at 120% allocation. Deliverable quality is starting to degrade and several critical bugs haven't been fixed for 2 sprints.
phoenix.action1: Launch express recruitment via specialized agency
phoenix.action2: Temporarily reassign 1 senior developer from Nova project

atlas.description: Functional scope is still not formally validated after 3 iterations. Change requests are multiplying and creating confusion in the development team.
atlas.action1: Organize framing workshop with all stakeholders
atlas.action2: Freeze scope and create phase 2 backlog

nova.description: Client validations systematically take 10+ days versus 3 days planned. This situation blocks progression and demotivates the team who must constantly review their priorities.
nova.action1: Escalate to client-side sponsor to accelerate decisions
nova.action3: Define contractual maximum validation period (5 days)
